tokenOptimizer.workspaceContextMode.description: Controls which workspace content Tokonomics may add to cloud model requests. Workspace trust is always required.

tokenOptimizer.includeUnsavedBuffers.description: Allow explicitly selected unsaved editor text to be attached. Disabled by default to avoid sending unreviewed buffer contents.

tokenOptimizer.enableContextGovernor.description: Enable deterministic task intent classification, risk-aware context optimization, and safety overrides.

tokenOptimizer.governorAggressiveness.description: Default optimization aggressiveness before risk-level override.

tokenOptimizer.enforceEvidenceSafetyGate.description: Mathematically enforce RequiredEvidence ⊆ ProvidedEvidence, failing closed on missing critical evidence.

tokenOptimizer.enableAstPruning.description: Enable AST structural code signature pruning across TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C#.

tokenOptimizer.enableCacheAlignment.description: Enable 1024-token prefix stabilization and 4-tier provider prompt cache alignment.

tokenOptimizer.enableTextCompression.description: Enable semantic token filtering on conversational logs and natural language contexts.

tokenOptimizer.compressionRatio.description: Target retention ratio for natural language prompt compression (0.1 to 0.9).

tokenOptimizer.targetProvider.description: Target cloud provider for prompt caching (default: 'auto' dynamically infers provider from the active model in the window).

tokenOptimizer.maxHistoryTurns.description: Maximum number of conversation history message turns to retain in active payload.

tokenOptimizer.stripDiffsAndLogs.description: Automatically compact verbose terminal logs, error traces, and git diffs in conversation history.

tokenOptimizer.targetUpstreamModelFamily.description: The upstream VS Code language model family (default: 'auto' dynamically detects the active model in the current window).

tokenOptimizer.enableDailyBudgetGuardrai.description: Optional: Enable daily token spend alert warnings when your daily spend approaches the budget ceiling.

tokenOptimizer.dailyBudgetUsd.description: Optional: Daily spend budget threshold in USD (active when enableDailyBudgetGuardrail is true).

tokenOptimizer.mcpSchemaCompression.description: MCP/Tool schema compression level. 'low': truncate descriptions. 'medium': strip descriptions + enums + defaults. 'high': collapse 15+ tools into a single meta-tool.

tokenOptimizer.enableDiffOutputOptimizat.description: Detect code edit/refactor intent and request unified diff patches instead of complete files; realized output-token changes depend on the model and task.

tokenOptimizer.enableModelRouting.description: Analyze task complexity and suggest optimal model tiers (Flash vs Standard vs Reasoning).

tokenOptimizer.enableResponseCache.description: Enable instant zero-token exact-hash response caching for read-only questions.

tokenOptimizer.tabRelevanceThreshold.description: Minimum relevance score (0-100) for including open editor tabs into context packs.

tokenOptimizer.maxIndexFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size (in KB) for workspace indexing. Files larger than this are skipped during repo mapping to preserve memory. Increase this if your project has large auto-generated files (e.g. protobuf, GraphQL schemas) that you want indexed.

tokenOptimizer.responseCacheMaxSize.description: Maximum number of cached AI responses held in memory. Lower this on machines with limited RAM.

tokenOptimizer.modelAllowList.description: Enterprise governance: restrict which model IDs or families are allowed. Leave empty to allow all models. Example: ['claude-3.5-sonnet', 'gpt-4o']. Blocked models will show a policy warning instead of sending the request.

tokenOptimizer.enableImageRightsizing.description: Apply bounded local rightsizing to eligible inline images and workspace-contained screenshot references before model submission.

tokenOptimizer.imageMaxDimension.description: Maximum dimension (width or height in pixels) for rightsized images. Lower values save more tokens but reduce image quality.

tokenOptimizer.ramBudgetMB.description: Maximum RAM (in MB) allocated for in-memory AST skeletons, PageRank graph, background pre-warming, and symbol search. Lower on low-RAM devices (e.g. 16MB/32MB); increase on large enterprise repos (e.g. 128MB/256MB).

tokenOptimizer.enableBackgroundRamWarmin.description: Asynchronously pre-warms the codebase in RAM on startup in idle micro-batches for 0ms first-prompt latency.

tokenOptimizer.enableRamSemanticIndex.description: Maintains a high-speed in-memory symbol search index in RAM to surgically retrieve referenced signatures without dumping full files.

tokenOptimizer.pipelineMode.description: Context compilation mode (compiler: full evidence-aware pipeline; hybrid: transitional; legacy: basic AST pruner).

tokenOptimizer.releaseChannel.description: Local release channel control. Canary uses deterministic staged enrollment; disabled preserves requests verbatim.

tokenOptimizer.stagedRolloutPercent.description: Percentage of installations enrolled when releaseChannel is canary. Assignment is deterministic and remains local.

tokenOptimizer.emergencyDisableOptimizat.description: Emergency local kill switch. When enabled, model requests retain their canonical payload without optimization.

tokenOptimizer.disabledCapabilities.description: Granular local kill switches used for staged rollout and incident containment.

tokenOptimizer.experimentalConsent.description: Explicitly consent to selected Phase 10 experiments running locally in shadow mode. Shadow results do not change model-bound output.

tokenOptimizer.experimentalFeatures.description: Opt-in Phase 10 shadow experiments. Selection also requires experimentalConsent.

tokenOptimizer.disabledExperiments.description: Independent local kill switches for Phase 10 experiments; disabled entries override consent and selection.

tokenOptimizer.experimentalMaxLatencyMs.description: Per-candidate shadow-computation latency ceiling. Over-budget results are discarded.

tokenOptimizer.experimentalMaxMemoryMB.description: Declared per-candidate memory ceiling; candidates exceeding it remain disabled.
